highlights.title: A fixed goal says who fixed it
highlights.text: When a bot's fix brings a broken goal back, the notice says "{bot}'s fix worked; its checks pass again." A goal that recovers on its own still says its checks pass again.

highlights.title: Goal notices give the real start time
highlights.text: A broken goal's notice now says when it first failed, the same time its row shows, not when the notice went out.
